cautions: Owner-supplied PDF research, not independently archive-verified. Source URLs are supplied citations, not proof that this import fetched or checked the cited page.
Exact regional identifiers remain independently searchable; they do not imply different hardware. No original PDFs, scans or complete conversations are published.
PRW-69 module 3514 is reported but exact individual support/manual matches remain unresolved. No firm module link is created.
OCW-G1200-2AJF approximately 106 g and OCW-G1200D-1AJF approximately 104 g retain their qualifications; the latter is a retailer measurement, not a factory specification.

Conflicting or existing scalar facts are retained. New source comparisons remain visible in scoped evidence. Suffix readings are series-specific community interpretations, not a universal official Casio decoder.
G-B001MVA: complete MVA manufacturer code retained; MV + A analytical only. No MVA case data copied to MVB/MVE. Dates distinguish announcement and Japan launch.

2023 correction: MV trio 75 g; RG/SF resin editions 59 g. Six Japanese identifiers use JR, never rewritten to JF. BEAMS full suffix/weight/day remain unresolved. Separate researched G/B/001/MV/A-B-E segments from complete official variant strings.
